gold_text: The system stores a name, a description, a price and an image for every product.
gen_text: Given products stored in the system, When a customer browses the product catalog, Then the system shall display the name, description, decimal price and image of each available product.

gold_text: An order item exists only as part of the order it belongs to, and cannot be moved to another order; when an order is removed from the system, its order items are removed with it.
gen_text: The system shall keep an order item in existence only as part of the order it belongs to, shall not allow an order item to be moved to another order, and shall remove the order items of an order when that order is removed.

gold_text: Given an order that is marked as shipped, When the system records the change, Then the status of its invoice and of any payment against that invoice remains unchanged.
gen_text: Given an order being set to shipped, When the status of the order changes to shipped, Then the system shall leave the status of an invoice and of any payment against that invoice unchanged.

gold_text: The status of a closed order cannot be changed.
gen_text: The system shall not change the status of an order whose status is closed.
